name: fyp_gui_harness
description: Drive the mock Instagram app through intents with a self-healing ladder (id > label > text > scoped > vision > keyboard). Every call prints one JSON document. On failure, `userMessage` must be relayed to the user as-is.

exit_codes.1: ran, could not finish - tell the user (needsUser=true)

tools.name: describe
tools.description: List intents, available UI breaks (chaos) and parameters.

tools.name: create_post
tools.command: node agent/fyp.mjs run --caption <caption> [--breaks B1,B4] [--arm healed|baseline] [--shot file.png]
tools.description: Run the full create-post flow (9 intents) and verify the post appears in the feed. Returns stepsOk/stepsTotal, per-step route used (id/label/text/scoped/vision, +keyboard), and, if it could not finish, needsUser=true with a first-person userMessage naming the step it is stuck on.

caption.description: Caption to post. Omit for a unique demo caption.

breaks.description: UI breaks to inject first (testing only). Never set for a real user task.

arm.description: baseline = recorded-locator script, for comparison only.

memory.description: Remember which route worked / failed (measurement only).

tools.name: run_intent
tools.description: Run ONE intent against the current app state (the runner starts a fresh page each call, so only post.open is valid cold; use create_post for the whole flow).

tools.name: accessibility_survey
tools.description: Per screen: how many controls expose no accessible name / no role. Screen readers face the same gaps.

tools.name: experiment
tools.description: Baseline vs healed, N repetitions over break configurations. Writes results.json, summary.csv, attempt-log.csv to <dir>. Slow: demo set is 6 configs x 2 arms per repetition.

tools.name: say
tools.command: node agent/fyp.mjs say "<what the user said>" [--speak]
tools.description: Plain English in. Maps one sentence to create_post / accessibility_survey / status / describe, or says honestly why not (not-understood, need-more: ask the user the `question`). Nothing runs unless the sentence maps exactly. The result carries `heard`, `understoodAs` and `spoken` (a sentence to read aloud); --speak says it with Windows speech.

tools.name: learn
tools.description: Does remembering routes pay off after the UI changes? R back-to-back runs; the app is healthy for the first K, then the breaks arrive. Run with route memory on and off; reports failed actions, time and runs-to-settle. Testing/measurement only.

tools.name: protect
tools.description: How does a site's protection layer (WAF, bot rules, rate limit, access gate) treat this agent? N fresh, unmodified, paced trials, each sorted into completed / challenged / access-gated / rate-limited / blocked / http-error / incomplete / unreachable, with 95% intervals. Measures and reports only: it never solves, spoofs or waits out a challenge.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Live app only: sign in with the login in the vault (never pass or print a password). If none is stored the result says so; the HUMAN runs `fyp.mjs vault set`.

tools.name: teach
tools.description: The HUMAN does a task once in a real window (press Enter in the terminal to finish). The harness learns each step (what was touched, how to find it again) and a success check from what changed on screen. It REFUSES a step it cannot verify, never records a password field, and saves agent/routines/<name>.json. An agent should ask the user to run this, not run it.

tools.name: routines
tools.description: List taught routines, their phrases and parameters.

tools.name: run_routine
tools.description: Replay a taught routine through the same ladder as the built-in flow (healing, route memory, keyboard route, honest failure). Replays at the window size it was taught at. Prefer `say` for user requests; use --arm baseline and --breaks only for measurement.
